name: eligible-source-baseline
description: Each source action assumes access to its block, mob, chest, or activity. No travel, fuel, tools, combat, spawning, or progression prerequisites are priced.
notes: Block tables whose block is a recipe output are excluded unless explicitly listed as naturally obtainable; this avoids free mining of crafted blocks.
Nested fishing categories are evaluated only through the root fishing activity. Other chest and entity tables represent repeatable encounters with access already available.
Special NBT recipes, item variants, trading, brewing, and world-generation acquisition paths absent from the data are not synthesized.
